logos.description: Square logo for nav and footer

hero.description: Main hero banner image for homepage top

products.description: Abstract teal geometric shape representing a 3D printed object (Geometric Plant Pot / Desktop Accessory)
Abstract purple/teal layered 3D curves representing a 3D printed object (Wall Art / Complex Print)

sections: Hero: Full-width background image using hero_background URL. Overlay with bg-[#0E5A5C]/40 to ensure text legibility. H1: 'Shop Unique 3D Printed Products'. Subtext: 'Functional, decorative, and custom 3D printed items crafted with precision.' Two buttons: Primary 'Shop Products', Secondary 'Request Custom Print'.

Featured Categories: Bento grid of 7 categories (Home Decor, Desk Accessories, Miniatures & Models, Replacement Parts, Tools & Gadgets, Gifts, Custom Prints) with dark petrol cards and gold hover borders.
Best Sellers: Horizontal scroll or 4-col grid of product_card components featuring 4 top products.
About/Value Props: 3-column section (Precision, Quality, Customization) using gold lucide-react icons.
Main Layout: 2-column. Left: filter_sidebar (Category, Material, Price Range, Color, Availability, Rating). Right: shop grid.
Controls: Top bar for 'Sort By' dropdown (Newest, Best Selling, Price Low→High, High→Low).
Product Stage: Split 50/50. Left: Image gallery (large main image + thumbnails). Right: Product info (Title, Rating, Price, Material badge, Color swatches, Qty selector, Add to Cart).
Description & Specs: Text block for Description, Material, Dimensions.

Form Section: 2-column layout inside a massive admin_dashboard style card. Left: Instructions & file requirements. Right: Form fields (Name, Email, Phone, Product Idea, Material, Color, Quantity, File Upload placeholder, Message, Submit Custom Request button).
Cart Drawer: slide-in from right, qty controls, subtotal, shipping estimate, checkout button.
Checkout Form: Simple placeholder checkout form with customer details + payment placeholder.
Top Nav: Admin user profile, quick stats.
Stats Row: 4 admin_dashboard cards (Revenue, Orders, Products, Pending Requests).
Main Content: 2-col. Left: Recent Orders & Products table. Right: Pending Custom Requests list. Add new product button.
Footer: logo (square), quick links, contact placeholders, social icons, brand description. Use dark background #0A4143.

microinteractions.hover_effects: Buttons glow with gold shadow on hover. Cards scale image slightly and fade in a gold border. Nav links have a gold underline animation on hover.
microinteractions.page_transitions: Fade in on load using Framer Motion.
microinteractions.cart_drawer: Slide in from right edge with a backdrop blur overlay on the main content.

testing.required_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-shop-link"', 'data-testid="add-to-cart-button"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Ensure stroke colors match the gold/teal theme.
Use 'framer-motion' for cart drawer slide-in, page transitions, and hover microinteractions.
Strictly adhere to the color palette. Backgrounds MUST be #0E5A5C, #0F5E60, or #0A4143. Accents MUST be #D4A53A.
Inject the font imports for Cabinet Grotesk and Outfit in the global CSS (index.css). Set body font to Outfit and heading font to Cabinet Grotesk.

Populate the product shop with at least 8 mocked products (Geometric Plant Pot, Cable Organizer Clips, Custom Keychain, Miniature Dragon Figure, Replacement Knob, Desk Phone Stand, Wall Art Panel, Tool Holder) utilizing the provided product_image URLs interchangeably.
The header logo MUST use the exact URL provided in media.logos.header_logo.
The homepage hero MUST use the exact URL provided in media.hero.hero_background as the background image.

Implement the UI using plain HTML/Tailwind for main structure, and Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Select, Tabs, Dialogs) but heavily override Shadcn styles to remove border-radius (rounded-none) and apply the dark petrol/gold theme.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Space Grotesk' fonts as requested by the user.
